item.text: The dataset loads as a 34-frame VTI sequence. I’ve confirmed the first three time steps and am using TTK’s field-tracking filter directly on the time series, which applies its persistence threshold before extracting maxima.

item.text:
Completed the 3-step cloud analysis and visualization.

- Visualization: [cloud_tracking_emd_3d.png](/workspace/output/cloud_tracking_emd_3d.png)
- Per-time-step field/maxima view: [cloud_tracking.png](/workspace/output/cloud_tracking.png)
- ParaView state (sphere glyph radius 2): [cloud_tracking.pvsm](/workspace/output/cloud_tracking.pvsm)
- EMD piecewise-linear track geometry: [tracked_maxima_emd.vtp](/workspace/output/tracked_maxima_emd.vtp)
- Reproducible script: [render_cloud_tracking.py](/workspace/render_cloud_tracking.py)

It uses the first three frames, threshold 0.5, warm-cold coloring, and produces 240 retained maxima with 160 EMD track segments.
